content: Vatulúkwana Aba Kaiyakaana kaba vatumna areko ana madágina manuna

E Yauwe tuwaina kana, ‘Tomota kulatuwokōidi latuwogu guna Kaba Kaiyaka yoyou simadagi ame nakae: Areko dedevidi toidi adi badabada yawou be nakae búyala noyanoyaidi buruu, kalaakovidi toidi be kayakayaidi sikabidi, e simadagi. Arekoyadi goi yábana ana tomatakavatayao makauyadi sigilumidi. Gilumayana ana kaigigita gíluma ana tokatanaki idi paisewa.
Go areko tamo tamo adi mamanao ovanima ovato go, adi papaeva ovatayamo. Areko liliudi adi kakainaki nakae.
E areko ainima adi mamanao goi sisavikoidi. Niga areko ainima sikabidi, adi mamanao goi sisavikoidi.
Go areko buruu sikabidi, látuma siyatakoidi go, latumayadi matakubudi aba vatumna areko tayamo ana mamanao goi sigilumipatukoidi. Aba vatumna areko aiyuwoina ana mamanao goi, nakae bei siguinuwe.
Aba vatumna areko tayamo ana mamanao goi ana látuma adi badabada 50 sigilumipatukoidi. E nakae aba vatumna areko aiyuwoina ana mamanao goi siguinuwe. Go latumayadi sivatuyuwedi.

Ikavava, aba talagegeta goura adi badabada 50 simadagidi, e aba talagegetayadi goi aba vatumna areko aiyuwokova sisavidi, e bei guna Kaba Kaiyakayana ana kaba vatumna ana kaigigita areko tayamo toito.
E tomota kulatuwokōidi latuwogu goti unuunudi sikabidi, areko yawou tayamo simadagidi. Arekoyadi guna Kaba Kaiyaka ana kaba vatumna siyatakoidi.
Arekoyadi tamo tamo adi mamanao ovanima ovato aba katugúyala. Go adi papaeva ovatayamo. Arekoyadi madabokidi adi kakainaki nakae.

Go arekoyadi ainima sikabidi, adi mamanao goi sisavikoidi. Niga arekoyadi ainima tayamo sikabidi, adi mamanao goi sisavikoidi. Go ame arekoyana goi guna Kaba Kaiyaka sivatum go, kaga ikesa, moe areko ainima tayamoina, e ana kaba siu goi siguyali.
Látuma areko ana badabada 50 sikabidi, matakubudi sigilumipatukoidi aba vatumna ana mamanao goi. Nakae siguinuwe aba vatumna aiyuwoina goi.
Ikavava, aba talagegeta kopwa ana badabada 50 simadagidi go, aba vatumna areko aiyuwokova adi látuma goi sivaisiudi sisavidi. Tauna aba vatumna areko tayamo maanawena.
Arekoyana panetayataya kasikasi ikesa Tukunu goi moe sikayabale ina sikayapatuko.
Go guna Kaba Kaiyaka salavavaina arekoyana ikesa aba katugúyala goi sikayabale ina sikayapatuko, e guna Kaba Kaiyaka ivatum.

Ikavava, aba vatumna aiyuwo tuwaina sigilumidi guna Kaba Kaiyakayana manuna. Tayamo sipi bolamo sakavaidi sikabidi aba vatumna tayamo sigilumi. Sakavaidiyadi sikaredi kayakayaidi. Go aiyuwoina yoguyogu sakavaidi sikabidi aba vatumna aiyuwoina sigilumi.’
Vatulúkwana Aba Kaiyaka ana vabodakalovaana madágina manuna
E Yauwe tuwaina kana, ‘Tomota kulatuwokōidi latuwogu gaigíyala taalaidi sikabidi, guna Kaba Kaiyakayana ana vabodakalova simadagidi.
Ana vabodakalova tamo tamo gidigidina ana tukotuko ovato go, adi mamanao panetayataya.
Vabodakalovayadi adi madágina ame nakae: Alova aiyuwo sivataoedi go, alova sikanabaledi alovayadi aiyuwo nauyayanaidi goi. Vabodakalova liliudi Aba Kaiyakayana goi simadagidi nakae.
Vabodakalova adi badabada 20 simadagidi Aba Kaiyakayana youya dadavina manuna.
Go vabodakalovayadi adi kaba táoya siriba adi badabada 40 simadagidi. Tauna aba táoya aiyuwo moe vabodakalova tayamo manuna. Nakae bei siguinuwe vabodakalova liliudi goi.
Go guna Kaba Kaiyakayana yawéyana dadavina goi nakae bei siguinuwe. Vabodakalova adi badabada 20 simadagidi
go, adi kaba táoya siriba adi badabada 40 simadagidi. Tauna aba táoya aiyuwo vabodakalova tayamo manuna.
Go Tukunu ana vaboda goi, moe koiboga dadavina, guna Kaba Kaiyakayana ana vabodakalova adi badabada ainima tayamo simadagidi.
Go guna Kaba Kaiyakayana matakubuna aiyuwo goi vabodakalova aiyuwo tuwaina simadagidi, sikalipaiwolidi. Moe yawéyana be koiboga adi valoboda goi be nakae youya be koiboga adi valoboda goi.
Sikalipaiwolidi, tauna ditonema unadi goi vabodakalova aiyuwo go, diligaema rini goura goi vabodakalovayadi sikopatukoidi. Tukunu ana vaboda matakubuna aiyuwo goi siguinuwe nakae.
Tuwo vabodakalova adi badabada ainima aito koiboga dadavina go, adi kaba táoya adi badabada yawou ainima tayamo. Moe aba táoya aiyuwo vabodakalova tayamo manuna.
Vabodakalovayadi simadagidi ikavava, latuwogu logógana gaigíyala ainima sibobóidi, e vabodakalova toluyedi youya dadavina goi sikanabaledi.
Ikavava, ainima tuwaina sibobóidi, e yawéyana dadavina sikanabaledi. Nakae ainima sibobóidi Tukunu koiboga dadavina nakae sikanabaledi.
Go rini goura siyatoidi vabodayadi toluyedi goi, e vaboda tamo tamo nauyayana logógana tayamo riniyadi goi sivaisiu ikanabalabala go, adi mamanao vaboda naveyadi.

Vabodakalovayadi liliudi goi goura paaevaidi bei sikaupatukoidi. Aiyuwoina logoganayadi goura paaevaidi goi sipaimidi go, gourayadi sikaupatukoidi. Ikavava, rini goura simadagidi, vabodakalova toluyena goi siyatoidi, e logoganayadi sivaisiudi.
E guna Kaba Kaiyakayana simadāgi nakae makayauna koyayana goi bogina avatulukoim kutapate.’
Vatulúkwana Tukunu Kimaasabaina Toinaana vabodaupa kaarekoina manuna

E Yauwe tuwaina kana, ‘Tomota kulatuwokōidi latuwogu búyala noyanoyaidi buruu, kalaakovidi toidi be kayakayaidi sikabidi be nakae areko dedevidi sikabidi, e gíluma ana tokatanaki sivini, vabodaupa kaarekoina tayamo igilumi. Arekoyana goi yábana ana tomatakavatayao makayaudi igilumidi.

Igilumidi ikavava, tomota kulatuwokōidi latuwogu kówala gaigíyala aivasi sibobóidi go, goura paaevaidi sikabidi, kowalayadi sipaimidi. Sipaimidi ikavava, adi kaba táoya siriba goi sivataoedi guna Kaba Kaiyakayana sinaena. Go aba talagegeta goura kowalayadi sipodi goi siyatoidi. Amoko goi arekoyana sivakosaine.

Latumayadi boi aba vatumna areko sisaavikoidi sobuyekoidi goi arekoyana sivakosaine. Sivakosaine ikavava, e aba vatulúkwana dedeogaina sikabi, sivaisiu vabodaupa kaarekoina sinaena siyato. Vabodaupayana Bateta Kimaasabaina be Tukunu Kimaasabaina Toina sivabodaupedi.
Dedeoga siyato ikavava, e aba núwala sikabi, Tukunu Kimaasabaina Toina goi sivaisiu aba vatulúkwana dedeogaina yatana goi sikailagasi.

Ikavava, teboroyana sikabi, sikaitakeve sinave guna Kaba Kaiyaka goi sivaisiu go, yawéyana dadavina vabodaupa kaarekoina toluyena goi siyato. Go rampa adi kaba yata sikabi, guna Kaba Kaiyaka goi sivaisiu go, youya dadavina vabodaupa kaarekoina toluyena goi siyato.

E guna Kaba Kaiyaka ana kaba siu moe bomatu dadavina goi bei ikaaiyaka. Aba siuyana kaarekoina ana gíluma ame nakae: Búyala noyanoyaidi buruu, kalaakovidi toidi be kayakayaidi be nakae areko dedevidi sikabidi, e gíluma ana tokatanaki bei sivini, igilumi.

Igilumi ikavava, tomota kulatuwokōidi latuwogu kówala gaigíyala ainima sibobóidi, e goura paaevaidi sikabidi, kowalayadi sipaimidi. Sipaimidi ikavava, adi kaba táoya kopwa simadagidi. Ikavava, goura sikabi aba siu karekoinayana adi kaba talagegeta simadagidi.’
